title: The Marvels
tagline: Three heroes. One very full kitchen.
about: Carol Danvers, Monica Rambeau and Kamala Khan keep swapping places every time they use their powers.
cue: Serve the mains when Carol lands in the Khan family living room in Jersey City.
faces: Fried pastry triangles of spiced potato, peas and onion
Popcorn tossed in lime zest, chilli flakes and melted butter
Yoghurt marinated chicken layered with basmati and crisp fried onions
Aladna lemon and oregano lamb skewers
Vanilla cupcakes piped with red, blue and gold swirls
Captain Marvel, my mom made way too much food. There's always way too much food.
Serve the mains when Carol lands in the Khan family living room in Jersey City.

Compliments of the captain. Prices subject to change, paid in ship's credit. Laser issue, fleet standard. Form G-23, sheet 2 of 2. 2023. Crew notes: Three heroes swapping places. Goose and the Flerkittens. Aladna, where everyone sings.

    StartersKhan family samosasFried pastry triangles of spiced potato, peas and onionHow to make it600g potatoes150g frozen peas1 brown onion1 tbsp garam masala1 packet spring roll pastry300g Greek yoghurt1 handful mint1 L vegetable oil, for fryingBoil the potatoes, then crush them with the peas.Fry the onion and garam masala and mix into the potato.Cut the pastry into strips, fill and fold into triangles.Fry in the oil at 180°C in batches until crisp.Blend the mint into the yoghurt for dipping.Space station popcornPopcorn tossed in lime zest, chilli flakes and melted butterHow to make it100g popping corn2 tbsp vegetable oil60g butter2 limes1 pinch chilli flakesZest the limes and melt the butter with the zest and chilli.Heat the oil in a large lidded pot and pop the corn, shaking now and then.Toss the butter through, add a squeeze of lime juice and serve in silver bowls.MainsJersey City chicken biryaniYoghurt marinated chicken layered with basmati and crisp fried onionsHow to make it1kg chicken thighs300g Greek yoghurt2 tbsp garam masala400g basmati rice2 brown onions2 tbsp vegetable oil1 pinch saffron100ml full cream milksalt, to tasteMarinate the chicken in the yoghurt, garam masala and a good pinch of salt for 2 hours.Rest the chicken in the fridge.Slice the onions and fry in the oil until crisp, soak the saffron in warm milk.Par-cook the rice in boiling water.Layer chicken, rice and onions in an ovenproof pot, drizzle with saffron milk and seal tightly.Bake at 170°C.Aladna lemon and oregano lamb skewersThe planet where everyone singsHow to make itAs written, serves 4Lamb skewers marinated in lemon, garlic and oregano, grilled and served with flatbread and herb salad.Cut 800g lamb leg into 3cm cubes and marinate 1 hour with the juice and zest of 1 lemon, 3 crushed garlic cloves, 2 tsp dried oregano, 3 tbsp olive oil and salt.Thread onto 8 skewers and grill over high heat for 8 to 10 minutes, turning, until charred outside and pink inside.Warm 4 flatbreads.Toss parsley, mint, tomato, cucumber and red onion with lemon and oil.Serve with the skewers and 200g tzatziki.SweetsKamala's fan art cupcakesVanilla cupcakes piped with red, blue and gold swirlsHow to make it125g butter, softened, for the cakes150g caster sugar2 eggs200g self-raising flour125ml full cream milk250g icing sugar125g butter, softened, for the buttercream3 tubes of gel food colouring (red, blue and gold)Heat the oven to 175°C and line a muffin tin.Beat the butter for the cakes with the caster sugar, beat in the eggs, then fold in flour and milk.Bake until golden.Cool completely.Beat the icing sugar with the butter for the buttercream, split into three colours with the food colouring and pipe swirls on top with a little star on each.DrinksMango lassiMango and cardamom lassiHow to make it2 mangoes300g Greek yoghurt250ml full cream milk1 tbsp caster sugar1 pinch ground cardamom1 bag icePeel and slice the mangoes.Blend with the yoghurt, milk, sugar and cardamom until smooth.Pour over ice in tall glasses.
